column1: # easywgs_markers curated marker list for module 06.4 (abricate custom database).
# This file lists the gene/locus markers used to screen the five tier-4 pathogen
# groups when no single maintained command-line serotyper exists. It is a
# shopping list and provenance table, NOT the database itself: the sequences are
# not shipped in git and are not auto-downloaded. Fetch each sequence from the
# cited RefSeq reference genome, VFDB or PubMLST record, concatenate them into
# one multi-FASTA whose headers start with marker_id, then build the database
#  marker_id     required FASTA header prefix (one sequence, or several alleles
#                sharing the prefix, e.g. CB_bont|A, CB_bont|B)
#  species_code  panel.tsv species_code the marker applies to
#  locus_class   species / surface_O / surface_K / surface_capsule / toxin /
#  description   what presence means and the typing limitation
#  sequence_source authoritative reference to extract the sequence from
# Presence/absence of a generic gene does NOT assign a type. O/K groups, Penner
# capsule types and BoNT subtypes require type-specific reference alleles; see
# the surface_* rows and the guidebook page "Specialized pathogens".
